en.headline: High Court dismisses Pan Qiaoxian’s appeal in case linked to Abby Choi murder
en.dek: Temporary Judge Cheung Kit-yi rejected the appeal against conviction and sentence, ordering the woman to begin her six-month jail term immediately for conspiring to help a man flee.
body: The High Court on Monday dismissed an appeal by Pan Qiaoxian against her conviction and six-month sentence for conspiring to pervert the course of justice.
Temporary Judge Cheung Kit-yi ruled that the appeal failed on both conviction and sentence. Pan, who had been on bail pending the appeal, must now serve the prison term at once.

The case relates to events in February 2023, when Pan was found to have conspired with another person to help a man known as Alex leave Hong Kong urgently and secretly through a route not managed by the Immigration Department. Alex is Kwong Kong-chi, the former husband of Abby Choi, who was killed and dismembered. A co-defendant, Lam Shun, was also convicted and sentenced to six months but did not appeal.
The court had earlier found that the defendants acted in anticipation that the man might face investigation or legal proceedings.

zh.headline: 高院駁回潘巧賢上訴 須即時服刑六個月
zh.dek: 暫委法官張潔宜裁定潘巧賢就串謀妨害司法公正的定罪及判刑上訴失敗，她須即時入獄服刑。
body: 高等法院周一駁回潘巧賢就串謀妨害司法公正罪的定罪及判刑提出的上訴。
暫委法官張潔宜頒下判詞，維持原審的定罪及六個月監禁刑期。潘巧賢早前獲准保釋等候上訴，現須即時開始服刑。
案件源於2023年2月，潘巧賢被裁定與另一人串謀，協助一名稱為Alex的男子緊急及秘密地經非入境事務處管理的途徑離開香港。該男子為蔡天鳳的前夫鄧港智。同案被告林舜同樣被裁定罪成並判囚六個月，但他沒有提出上訴。
法庭早前認為，被告在預期該男子可能面對調查或法律程序的情況下行事。
